verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents expired or revoked Item statuses, login-required error codes, or a Link update mode for re-authenticating an existing connection. The closest items are general webhooks about Item changes and generic SDK error handling. These are adjacent to the story and do not show a repair flow that avoids starting over.

support.subject: As an ops lead, broken connections are repairable — expired or revoked links surface as documented statuses, and users can re-authenticate in an update flow without starting over
